name: What are the benefits of installing new windows?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of installing new windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: New windows can significantly improve your home's energy efficiency by reducing drafts and heat transfer, leading to lower utility bills. They also enhance your home's curb appeal, increase property value, and can reduce outside noise. Modern windows offer improved security features and are easier to maintain than older models, providing a more comfortable and quieter indoor environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: New windows improve energy efficiency, enhance curb appeal, increase property value, reduce noise, and offer better security.
